name: Hobbiton
description: The peaceful homeland of hobbits, with its rolling green hills and cozy hobbit-holes. Here begins the greatest journey of the Third Age.

name: Bree
description: A bustling village where Men and Hobbits live side by side. The Prancing Pony inn stands at the crossroads of the ancient Great East Road.

name: Rivendell
description: The Last Homely House, hidden valley refuge of the Elves. Here the Fellowship was formed under Elrond's guidance.

name: Lothlorien
description: The Golden Wood, realm of Galadriel and Celeborn. Ancient mallorn trees tower above, and time itself seems to move differently here.

name: Parth Galen
description: The green lawn beside the Falls of Rauros, where the Fellowship was broken. Here the Company made their fateful choice.

name: The Black Gates
description: The Morannon, mighty fortress guarding the entrance to Mordor. Impassable to all but the most desperate or foolish.

name: Minas Morgul
description: The Tower of Sorcery, once fair Minas Ithil. Now a place of dread, glowing with a corpse-light under the shadow of the mountains.

name: Mount Doom
description: Orodruin, the Fire Mountain where the One Ring was forged and where it must be destroyed. The end of all things, or a new beginning.
